title: API: DELETE /api/portfolio/positions/{id}
description: Implement the route body in app/api/routers/portfolio.py (currently a 501 stub). Route signature is already wired.

checklist.step: Route signature already defined (204 No Content on success)
Implement handler: delete PositionORM by id, 404 if not found
Write integration test covering successful delete and delete-of-unknown-id
Run pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing and confirm no regression

decisions.decision: 404 error detail is a single ErrorDetail-shaped string ("Position '<id>' not found"), consistent with the route's existing `responses={404: {"model": ErrorDetail, ...}}` declaration and with how add_position's merge-overflow guard raises its own single-string 422. No new schema was introduced.
decisions.rationale: The route signature/response contract (including the 404 responses entry) was already finalized by a prior task and required no change, so the only remaining judgment call was the exact lookup/delete mechanics. Used Session.get(PositionORM, position_id) (primary-key lookup, the SQLAlchemy-idiomatic form) rather than a filter().one_or_none() query, mirroring how GET /api/portfolio's account lookup already uses db.get(AccountORM, 1). Rejected returning 204 on delete-of-unknown-id (silently succeeding) since API.md and the route's own responses={} already commit to 404 for that case, and idempotent-delete-as-204 wasn't asked for anywhere in the docs.
